scientific_integrity: The exact all-size proof uses marked-block counting, strict log-concavity of positive coefficient convolutions, and the deterministic excess-count identity. Independent finite enumerations corroborate but do not prove the all-size theorem.
scientific_limitations: The transition location is specified by exact Stirling-number inequalities, not by a simplified threshold expression. No monotonicity of unnormalized covariance magnitudes or extension to nonuniform boxes is claimed; historical priority, including implicit earlier specializations, is not established.
title: A single covariance sign transition among block sizes at fixed partition richness
